integrity: Proof uses exact eta and Eisenstein transformations plus a saddle-point minor-arc bound; finite integer checks are supplemental and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the first three asymptotic terms of the average even-part mass are asserted; the remainder is O(n^{-1/2}) without an effective constant or threshold. Priority relative to unindexed stronger general work is unresolved.
title: A three-term asymptotic for even-part mass in cubic partitions
